wins: Mapped perimeter services early in the episode and documented HTTP (port 80) response details, setting stage for focused exploitation attempts.
Captured default web application directory structure enabling rapid identification of potential injection vectors in subsequent runs.
fails: Repeated privilege escalation attempts stalled after gaining low-priv shell; lateral movement not achieved within episode constraints.
Inadequate persistence mechanism implementation—session termination occurred after recon phase without establishing foothold.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase was executed efficiently, yielding key service fingerprints, but follow-on exploitation and persistence efforts consistently fell short, preventing mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation stalled after enumerating local sudo capabilities; no high-priv shell obtained despite multiple service checks.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP port 80 responds with directory listing or default page
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto followed by curl to fetch config endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When low-priv shell exposes sudo rights without password
skill_cards.then_action: Execute sudo -l to enumerate commands, then script escalation with sudoedit or targeted binary

memory_ops.reason: Consistent reconnaissance payoffs when identifying web directory clues led to actionable follow-up targets.

next_experiments.title: Automate sudo exploitation checklist
next_experiments.description: Integrate scripted sudo enumeration plus safe exploitation path (sudoedit/vim) to reliably escalate once low-priv shell found.

next_experiments.title: Pivot from HTTP findings to exploit-specific tooling
next_experiments.description: Correlate nikto/curl discoveries with Metasploit auxiliary scanners for confirmed CVEs on the HTTP service to reduce manual guesswork.
